name: @lenticule-science/finite-program-measurement-service
description: Measures an explicitly supplied finite total relation against optional source-digested, customer-authored observations, then appends its own result, receipt, book, event, ActivityStreams, and EAVT evidence. Use when a customer needs an exhaustive finite-model measurement over its own supplied relation without formal Lean proof and without any independent verification of the supplied observations.
